subject.title: Stale .jsonl.lock + stuck typing indicator after EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError on parallel subagent fan-out

question: Should this issue remain the concrete Telegram/subagent fan-out tracker, or should maintainers migrate its remaining evidence into #101863 plus narrower delivery and typing issues?
rationale: Current main only solves slices of the report, and the remaining work crosses lifecycle policy, delivery durability, typing cleanup, and related open PR sequencing that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Keep As Concrete Repro Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open until the related lifecycle, delivery, typing, and fence fixes land with live proof against the reported user path.

options.title: Migrate To Umbrella And Narrow Issues
options.body: Move the unique evidence into #101863, #97021, and #100872, then close this only after maintainers confirm no separate Telegram/subagent fan-out tracker is needed.

options.title: Close After Partial Fixes
options.body: Close now based on retained-lock improvements, accepting that delivery discard and typing lifecycle gaps will remain tracked elsewhere only if users re-report them.

recommendation.title: Keep As Concrete Repro Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the related lifecycle, delivery, typing, and fence fixes land with live proof against the reported user path.

likelyOwner.reason: The open #101863 umbrella authored by obviyus is the clearest current owner for the remaining lifecycle design choice.
